source.coordinateMethod: Official WGS84 Point geometry; no local conversion or averaging

mappingBasis.mtr: Explicit MTR station-code to iGeoCom GEONAMEID crosswalk: TRS/RSN classification, unique bilingual operator station identity (two documented glyph variants). Each entrance ID is allowlisted and has matching official E_SITENAME and C_SITENAME parent fields; no proximity join or fuzzy acceptance.
mappingBasis.lightRail: Explicit MTR Light Rail numeric stop-ID to iGeoCom GEONAMEID crosswalk: TRS/LRA classification, unique exact bilingual current operator stop identity and Light Rail service-area coordinates. LRA is a station-level reference, not a verified centre, entrance or platform.

unresolvedSourceRecords.reason: Diamond Hill D access has no E_SITENAME/C_SITENAME parent association in this snapshot; withheld rather than assigning by name alone.
